nodes.label: Deploy options research (Vercel Hobby chosen)
nodes.rationale: The app is stateless with all persistence in external managed services, and Auth0 middleware + server actions need a full Node runtime, which ranks Vercel/Netlify/Railway above Cloudflare's edge-first Workers runtime.

nodes.label: Vercel Hobby chosen as cheapest/simplest host
nodes.rationale: $0 and zero-config native Next.js support fit an app with nothing exceeding the Hobby tier; Netlify is the fallback if the project becomes commercial since Hobby is non-commercial-only.

nodes.label: Auth0 middleware requires full Node runtime, not edge
nodes.rationale: auth0.middleware() and server actions want full Node.js APIs, which ranks Cloudflare's Workers/edge-first runtime as a poor fit versus Vercel/Netlify/Railway/Render.
